items.name: Lenore Fedow
items.review: We reached out to have our steps repaired. The work was done quickly and at an affordable price!

items.name: Charlotte M
items.review: Hammer Brick & Home just did a phenomenal job upgrading my kitchen. The team at HB&H were very thorough, neat & helpful. Despite some uneven walls from a previous contractor they did an excellent job installing my countertops. They truly take pride in their work. We'll be using them again!

items.name: Lin Dee
items.review: I couldn’t be happier with the work done by Hammer Brick & Home! They repaired the broken steps in front of the house and did an excellent job from start to finish. The quality of the workmanship was outstanding, the steps look great, and they paid close attention to the details. They were professional, reliable, and took pride in their work. Highly recommend Hammer Brick & Home to anyone looking for quality masonry and home repair work!

items.name: Simone Rivera
items.review: Just had a bathroom renovation completed by Hammer Brick & Home. The team was very professional, completed the work in a timely fashion, and prices were fair. I would contact them again for future repair and renovations.

items.name: Elizabeth Del Priore
items.review: I recently had a great experience with Norman, owner of Hammer Brick and Home. He showed up on time for a small job, which is often the hardest thing to find reliable help for. I had just completed an inspection that required several immediate repairs and needed everything done within 48 hours. Norman made it happen. He was respectful, professional, reliable and willing to help on short notice. I would definitely recommend Norman and Hammer Brick and Home.

items.name: Aksam Rafiz
items.review: Hardworking and honest people, difficult to come by nowadays. Highly recommend them.

items.name: Terry Kahn
items.review: I’ve known the owner for a long time, but seeing his work firsthand is truly impressive. Hammer Brick & Home LLC handled our project with incredible attention to detail. They are professional, licensed, and clearly take pride in every brick they lay. If you want someone honest and hardworking, this is the company to call!!!

items.name: Maverick Khan
items.review: Noman at Hammer Brick Home LLC did an amazing job from start to finish. Very professional, honest pricing, and great communication throughout the whole project. The work came out clean and high quality, and everything was completed on time just like promised. You can tell he really cares about the details and making sure the customer is happy.

items.name: Marques Parker
items.review: I was on the Nextdoor app looking to have my pavers pressure washed, sanded and sealed. Norman was one of many to reach out to me for a free estimate. He wasn't the cheapest but his price wasn't far off from them. I chose him because he was able to accommodate my time period. He assured me that I would be happy with the work; and he didn't disappoint. He even called back a couple of days later to follow up on my pavers. I would definitely reach out to them for any future plans.

items.name: Melvin Berfond
items.review: Hammer Brick did a great job on our front steps. Noman was at the jobsite everyday and made sure the work was done to our satisfaction.

items.name: Oscar Ramos
items.review: Great response to my changes when adding a new job.

items.name: Steven Nahas
items.review: I had hired Hammer Brick & Home LLC to do some work in my house. I was highly impressed with the work they had done. They were very professional, came on time, and the work was done in the time frame they said it would be done. The work was fantastic and they cleaned up great, no mess at all. I highly recommend them and will tell my friends and neighbors. 5 stars across the board.

items.name: Loren Ellis Art
items.review: I looked for a LOCAL Staten Islander to hire and wanted to support our local community. Norman and his assistant with Hammer Brick and Home LLC came to the rescue! They were great to work with and very concerned about doing a super job. They welcomed questions and concerns. Their work was great and priced fairly. I will be working with Hammer Brick & Home again. I recommend them without reservation.
